    52  // define this function, it is only declared in rawspeed:
    53  // for fuzzing, do not want any threading.
    54  extern "C" int __attribute__((const)) rawspeed_get_number_of_processor_cores() {
    55    return 1;
    56  }
    57
    58  static const rawspeed::CameraMetaData metadata{};
    59
    60  extern "C" int LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(const uint8_t* Data, size_t Size);
    61
    62  using rawspeed::DECODER;
    63
    64  extern "C" int LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(const uint8_t* Data, size_t Size) {
    65    assert(Data);
    66
    67    try {
    68      const rawspeed::Buffer buffer(Data, Size);
    69      auto ifd = rawspeed::TiffParser::parse(buffer);
    70
    71      // ATM do not care if this is the appropriate decoder.
    72      // only check that the check does not crash.
    73      (void)DECODER::isAppropriateDecoder(ifd.get(), &buffer);
    74
    75      auto decoder = rawspeed::make_unique<DECODER>(std::move(ifd), &buffer);
    76
    77      decoder->applyCrop = false;
    78      decoder->failOnUnknown = false;
    79      // decoder->checkSupport(&metadata);
    80
    81      decoder->decodeRaw();
    82      decoder->decodeMetaData(&metadata);
    83
    84    } catch (rawspeed::RawspeedException&) {
    85      return 0;
    86    }
    87
    88    return 0;
    89  }
